title: Android website blocker that never phones home
user: Android users who want a permanent, hard-to-bypass block on specific sites without a focus-app subscription or an app that logs their browsing; job: block a domain list device-wide with no data collection.
smallest_useful_product: Android app: local VpnService DNS interceptor with user-managed block list (wildcards), import/export list, optional unlock delay/timer, no permissions beyond VPN, no analytics.
monetization: free (open source); optional one-time support IAP
constraints: Encrypted DNS may bypass DNS interception
Uninstalling the app bypasses commitment features
